title: 第12章 她就在这等着
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
阮惜惜摇摇头，“她是瑶池圣女，生来尊贵，我若是她，或许也会同她那般吧……”

    “惜惜，我知道你不会。”云鹤珏抱紧怀中人儿，语气坚定道：“路仙瑶不是有玄天灵参吗？我去找她，有了玄天灵参，定能助你恢复。”

    想到路仙瑶对自己的痴迷，他心中笃定，只要他开口，她定会乖乖奉上！

    阮惜惜在他怀里轻轻摇头，纤细的手指抓住他胸前的衣襟，眼中泛起水光，“不，师兄…你不要去…”

    “那可是瑶池的万年灵参，何等珍贵，你去了，我怕……”

    “可她欠你的，必须还回来！”云鹤珏知道她担心自己，但他更在乎她。

    虽然淡了不少她脸上的刀疤，可每次看到，依旧让他更厌恶路仙瑶。

    惜惜多美的一张脸，竟被这恶毒的女人划伤，实在可恨！

    待他寻到机会，定要为惜惜讨回来！

    “即便没有玄天灵参，过些日子，苍山不是要开启了吗？苍山里有许多奇珍异宝，届时，我遮容混进去……”

    “苍山里纵然奇珍异宝多得数不胜数，但那都比不上玄天灵参，能让你更快解毒！而且，苍山里头凶险未知，我怎能让你冒险？”云鹤珏满眼心疼地看着她。

    她这般坚强，从不愿给他添麻烦，怎能让他不心疼？

    “可我每次看到师兄你与她站在一起，心里……心里就……”阮惜惜欲言又止。

    这未尽之语，像羽毛一样撩乱着过云鹤珏的心。

    他低头看着阮惜惜泫然欲泣、满心满眼只有自己的模样，心中对她那份怜惜更盛了几分。

    他将她拥得更紧，“惜惜，我何德何能，能得你如此倾心相待……”

    这份全然依赖的爱意，与路仙瑶的死缠烂打形成鲜明对比，让他更坚定了阮惜惜才是他值得珍惜的人。

    阮惜惜从他怀中微微仰起脸，那双含泪的眸子深深凝望着他，“鹤珏师兄，惜惜此生能与师兄相遇、相爱……便是上天最大的恩赐，惜惜真的已经满足了。”

    她抬手，轻轻抚上他的脸颊，声音带着无尽深情。

    这深情告白如同点燃的火苗，瞬间燎原。

    云鹤珏情动不已，胸中爱意翻涌，他握住阮惜惜抚在自己脸上的手，感受着那微凉的触感，目光落在她苍白却诱人的唇瓣上，头不由自主地缓缓低下，只想将满腔怜惜与承诺印在那抹柔软之上……

    “云师兄！云师兄不好了！”

    一个惊慌失措的声音，在洞府外响起。
content_en:
Ruan Xixi shook her head, "She is the Saint of Yaochi, born to be noble. If I were her, maybe I would be like her..."

    "Xixi, I know you won't." Yun Hejue hugged the person in his arms tightly and said firmly: "Didn't Lu Xianyao have the Xuantian Spiritual Ginseng? I'll go find her. With the Xuantian Spiritual Ginseng, I will definitely help you recover."

    Thinking of Lu Xianyao's obsession with him, he was sure that as long as he asked, she would obey him!

    Ruan Xixi shook her head gently in his arms, her slender fingers grasped the skirt of his chest, her eyes filled with water, "No, senior brother... don't go..."

    "That's Yaochi's ten thousand year old ginseng. It's so precious. If you go there, I'm afraid..."

    "But what she owes you must be paid back!" Yun Hejue knew that she was worried about him, but he cared about her more.

    Although the scar on her face has faded a lot, it still makes him hate Lu Xianyao more every time he sees it.

    It's so hateful that such a beautiful face was scratched by this vicious woman!

    When he finds the opportunity, he will definitely get it back for Xixi!

    "Even if there is no Xuantian Spirit Ginseng, won't Cangshan Mountain be opened in a few days? There are many rare treasures in Cangshan Mountain. When the time comes, I will hide my face and sneak in..."

    "Even though there are countless rare treasures in Cangshan Mountain, they are not as good as Xuantian Spirit Ginseng, which can help you detoxify faster! Moreover, Cangshan Mountain is dangerous and unknown, how can I let you take risks?" Yun Hejue looked at her with distressed eyes.

    She is so strong and never wants to cause trouble to him, how can she not make him feel distressed?

    "But every time I see you, senior brother, standing together with her, my heart...my heart..." Ruan Xixi hesitated to speak.

    These unfinished words ruffled Yun Hejue's heart like feathers.

    He looked down at Ruan Xixi, who was about to cry, with only himself in her heart and eyes, and the pity for her in his heart became even greater.

    He hugged her tighter, "Xixi, how could I be worthy enough to have you treat me so lovingly..."

    This completely dependent love was in sharp contrast to Lu Xianyao's persistent pursuit, which made him more determined that Ruan Xixi was the one he deserved to cherish.

    Ruan Xixi raised her face slightly from his arms, staring deeply at him with her tearful eyes, "Senior Brother Hejue, Xixi is able to meet and fall in love with senior brother in this life... It is the greatest gift from God, and Xixi is truly satisfied."

    She raised her hand and gently touched his cheek, her voice filled with endless affection.

    This affectionate confession was like a fire that started a prairie fire in an instant.

    Yun Hejue was overwhelmed with emotion, and love surged in his chest. He held Ruan Xixi's hand on his face, feeling the slightly cool touch, and his eyes fell on her pale but alluring lips. His head slowly lowered involuntarily, wanting only to imprint his full compassion and promise on that softness...

    "Senior Brother Yun! Senior Brother Yun is in trouble!"

    A panicked voice sounded outside the cave.
